verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Self-hosting for data control and audit logging are adjacent features, not an opt-out capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
